request.instructions: The statement is taken from file docs/src/integrate/integration-tutorial.md, section "View the Tutorial Code". Statement and source are sections of the documentation of one project at one commit. First decide whether they describe the SAME thing. If they are about different packages, frameworks, classes, hooks, options, functions, file formats, or about different released versions (for example two migration guides for different versions), the statement is NOT STATED, never contradicted. Mark it contradicted only when the source gives an incompatible value, version, limit, name, list or rule for that same thing in the same scope. An example value in a code sample that overrides a default does not contradict the default.
